findings.note: re-audit 2026-10-04: AUTH-001 held (#40); key still 0640 at ba4becb

findings.title: Branch protection / required checks cannot be enforced on the current GitHub plan
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to GitHub Pro/Team and apply the ready payload (BRANCH_PROTECTION.md:576-587); until then keep compensating controls and re-review at each plan/cost review.

findings.title: Chain: co-tenant read of the agent key -> control-plane signing seed compromise -> unattended fleet code swap
findings.note: synthesised from AUTH/FILE/SUPPLY/ARCH findings at ba4becb
findings.recommendation: Break the chain at each link: keep the agent key 0600 with a distinct Vector identity; isolate the control plane host; disable auto-apply by default; set update_allowed_hosts. Each single fix degrades the chain.
